title: The Void That Shouldn't Exist
topic: There is a place in space so empty that scientists found it deeply unsettling. It is called the Boötes Void. Discovered in 1981, it sits about 700 million light-years from Earth. The void stretches across 330 million light-years. A normal region that size should hold around 2,000 galaxies. Instead, astronomers found only about 60 to 70 faint galaxies hiding inside it. title: The Great Attractor Mystery
topic: In 1986, astronomers traced galaxy motions and found something impossible. A hundred thousand galaxies are being pulled toward a single point in space. This region is called the Great Attractor. The structure spans a billion light-years across and sits roughly 150 million light-years from Earth. It should not exist.
